message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, type assertions, or value-range guards are performed on incoming data (e.g., 'data' in create_forecast or 'data' in post_scores) before use.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read from local CSV files and a local pickle file with no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks on any source.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution checks, expected label set validation, or label-noise detection tools are used anywhere in the data preparation or training flow.
No detected data poisoning defenses: Data is read from CSV and fed directly into Prophet without any outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious input values.

No detected model integrity verification: The model is loaded via `pickle.load(open('model.sav', 'rb'))` with no hash check, signature verification, pinned revision, or controlled-source validation before deserialization.

No detected label distribution validation: The train_model function reads the CSV and directly fits Prophet without any label distribution check, class balance validation, or anomaly detection on training samples.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation-pattern analysis, trigger detection, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or applied during model training.

No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no adversarial robustness testing of any kind; the evaluation only computes standard regression metrics (R2, MSE, MAE) on actual vs. forecast values.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no isolation of a held-out test set, no signing or hashing of evaluation data, and no guard against using training data for scoring; metrics are computed from CSV files with no integrity checks.

No detected input sanitization: The code directly uses user-supplied values (e.g., data['length'], data['name'], forecast_name) without any validation, schema checks, or sanitization of shape, type, or range.
No detected output bounds checks: The predict() function returns forecast values directly without any NaN guards, range/bounds checks, or sanity validation before saving or returning results.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a time-series forecasting model (fbprophet), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
